items.name: Glue workflows
items.text: Chains Glue crawlers/jobs via scheduled, on-demand, conditional (ALL/ANY), or EB triggers. Shares run properties; supports blueprints.

items.name: EventBridge
items.text: Rules route AWS/custom/SaaS events to targets; Scheduler runs cron/rate jobs; Pipes link SQS, Kinesis, DDB Streams, or MSK with filters.

items.name: Lambda chaining
items.text: Sync chaining adds tight coupling, idle wait cost, 15-min limit, and manual retries. Use Lambda for steps or starting jobs, not waiting.

items: Glue workflows cannot call non-Glue services (Lambda, EMR, Redshift); use Step Functions or MWAA.
Least ops overhead for new AWS-only pipelines = Step Functions (not MWAA); avoid EC2 cron (use EventBridge Scheduler).
S3 Event Notifications cannot start Glue directly; route via EventBridge, Lambda, or a Glue workflow EB trigger.
Event-driven pipelines must be idempotent because events can be duplicated or arrive out of order.
